description: Customer tickets with the triage an experienced support engineer would choose. Priority follows knowledge-base/process/incident-response-process.md: P1 core flow (checkout, login) failing for many; P2 core flow degraded or a secondary flow down; P3 minor or single-customer degradation with a workaround; P4 cosmetic or a question. Labelled by hand, independently of the classifier's word lists; 'difficulty' marks vague or misleading wording.

cases.title: Payment screen times out after login
cases.description: Several customers report that checkout freezes after clicking "Pay".

cases.title: Payment fails after pressing "Confirm Order"
cases.description: Merchant m_412 says 4 of their last 10 orders failed at payment with a generic error.

cases.title: Card payments declined for everyone since 10:05
cases.description: All card payments on our store are failing with 'payment could not be processed'. Customers cannot buy anything.

cases.title: Refund not received after 10 days
cases.description: A shopper says the refund for order ORD-55120 never arrived on their card.

cases.title: Question about payout schedule
cases.description: When do merchant payouts run each week?

cases.title: Checkout spinner never stops
cases.description: Many buyers stuck on the spinner after entering card details, then the page errors out.

cases.title: Stripe shows charges but orders say unpaid
cases.description: Three orders today were charged in Stripe but our order list still shows them as pending payment.

cases.title: Double charge on one order
cases.description: One customer was charged twice for ORD-77310. Please refund one of them.

cases.title: Apple Pay button missing on mobile
cases.description: The Apple Pay option disappeared from checkout on iPhone; card payment still works.

cases.title: Nobody can log in
cases.description: All of our staff get 'invalid session' immediately after entering their password. We cannot sign in at all.

cases.title: Users are receiving HTTP 500 when resetting passwords
cases.description: Support received 12 chats in 20 minutes: 'Forgot password' shows an error page.

cases.title: Account locked after one wrong password
cases.description: A merchant says their account locked after a single typo in the password.

cases.title: MFA code never arrives
cases.description: A user does not receive the SMS code for two-factor login; they tried three times.

cases.title: Logged out every few minutes
cases.description: Several merchants are being logged out of the admin every 5-10 minutes and lose unsaved work.

cases.title: Login page slow this morning
cases.description: Sign-in takes about 8 seconds for our team, but it works.

cases.title: How do I change my account email?
cases.description: Where can I update the email address used to sign in?

cases.title: Password reset link expired immediately
cases.description: Clicking the reset link from the email says 'link expired' even when opened right away. Happens for me and a colleague.

cases.title: Order export to CSV is empty
cases.description: Exporting last month's orders produces a CSV with only the header row.

cases.title: Orders stuck in 'processing'
cases.description: Since this afternoon every new order stays in 'processing' and never moves to 'confirmed'. Multiple merchants affected.

cases.title: Invoice shows wrong VAT
cases.description: Invoices for Greek customers show 20% VAT instead of 24%.

cases.title: Cart empties on refresh
cases.description: Shoppers lose their cart contents if they refresh the page. Reported by a few customers.

cases.title: Inventory count not updating
cases.description: After a sale the stock level stays the same; we oversold one product today.

cases.title: How do I export orders?
cases.description: Is there a way to download all orders as a spreadsheet?

cases.title: Shipment status not syncing
cases.description: Tracking numbers we add are not shown to buyers on the order page.

cases.title: Customer did not receive receipt
cases.description: A buyer says no order confirmation email arrived for ORD-61902.

cases.title: No emails going out at all
cases.description: None of our customers are getting order confirmation or shipping emails since 09:00. Many complaints.

cases.title: Webhook deliveries failing
cases.description: Our order.created webhook endpoint stopped receiving events; the dashboard shows delivery errors.

cases.title: Typo in the shipping email subject
cases.description: The subject says 'Your order has shiped'.

cases.title: Emails land in spam
cases.description: Several customers say our order emails go to their spam folder.

cases.title: Duplicate notification emails
cases.description: Each customer gets the shipping confirmation three times.

cases.title: Dashboard takes 30 seconds to load after login
cases.description: Merchants report the dashboard spinner for ~30 s, sometimes ending in an error page.

cases.title: Whole admin is sluggish
cases.description: Every page in the merchant admin takes several seconds today. It works, just slowly.

cases.title: Reports page never finishes loading
cases.description: The revenue report keeps loading for minutes and then shows a timeout error, for all of our stores.

cases.title: Product search slow
cases.description: Searching products in the admin takes 5-6 seconds for one merchant with a large catalogue.

cases.title: Storefront lag at peak hours
cases.description: Between 18:00 and 20:00 the storefront feels laggy for customers; latency graphs show spikes.

cases.title: Database connection errors in logs
cases.description: Our integration partner sees 'could not obtain connection' errors from your API about every minute.

cases.title: Read replica lagging
cases.description: Analytics numbers are 40 minutes behind live data; looks like replica lag.

cases.title: Deadlock errors when bulk editing products
cases.description: Bulk price edits fail with 'deadlock detected' about half the time.

cases.title: Cannot update store logo
cases.description: Uploading a new logo shows a success message but the old logo stays.

cases.title: API key rotation question
cases.description: What is the recommended way to rotate our API key without downtime?

cases.title: Something is weird
cases.description: Customers are complaining, not sure what is going on, please check.

cases.title: Wrong colour on the buy button
cases.description: The buy button turned grey after your last update; we want our brand blue back.

cases.title: Feature request: dark mode
cases.description: Would love a dark theme in the merchant admin.

cases.title: Customers see an error at the last step
cases.description: Several shoppers tell us that at the very last step of buying they get 'something went wrong'.

cases.title: Can't get into my account
cases.description: I typed my password correctly but it keeps saying wrong credentials. Only me as far as I know.

cases.title: Merchants say their numbers are missing
cases.description: Many merchants open the dashboard and see zero orders for today, although orders are coming in.

cases.title: Checkout works but confirmation email missing for all
cases.description: Payments go through fine, but since the morning no buyer receives the order confirmation.

cases.title: Login fine, but payment page shows 500
cases.description: After logging in, customers who go to pay get an HTTP 500. Started 20 minutes ago, many reports.

cases.title: Password reset email takes an hour
cases.description: Reset emails arrive about 60 minutes late for several users.

cases.title: Slow queries after the migration
cases.description: Since last night's maintenance, order listing queries take 10+ seconds; our DBA suspects a missing index.
